data.title: Pronouns — Starter · Lesson 6
data.subject: pronouns
data.lyrics:
[Spoken Ad-lib] Uh, let's start cooking.

[Hook]
Cooking up… Cocinando
In the kitchen… En la cocina
Stirring slow… Revolviendo lento
Feel the rhythm… Siente el ritmo
Let's get in the groove.

[Verse]
Tonight we're making something new,
we… nosotros are in the zone.
vosotros… you all can chop the veggies,
while I take care of the phone.
ellas… they, the spices, dancing in the pan,
Ustedes… you all, come taste if you can.
ellos… they, the flavors, blending so right,
les… to them, we give a try tonight.

[Hook]
Cooking up… Cocinando
In the kitchen… En la cocina
Stirring slow… Revolviendo lento
Feel the rhythm… Siente el ritmo
Let's get in the groove.

[Verse]
With a dash of love, consigo… with him, with her, with you,
we create a meal that's true.
mí… me, I taste and smile,
ti… you, you do it with style.
le… to him, to her, to you, we pass the plate,
sharing joy, it feels so great.
yo… I, te… you, we laugh and sing,
in the kitchen, everything's a fling.

[Bridge]
